subject.title: feat(memory): add multi-slot memory role architecture

question: Should OpenClaw adopt the five public memory-role slots and per-agent overrides as the permanent plugin/config contract, with legacy `plugins.slots.memory` migrated by Doctor rather than interpreted at runtime?
rationale: This PR creates a broad public configuration and plugin-hook contract; maintainers must choose its supported roles, migration window, and compatibility promise before implementation can safely be finalized.

options.title: Sponsor canonical roles with Doctor migration
options.body: Keep the role model, remove legacy runtime fallback readers, and require a bounded Doctor migration plus upgrade proof.

options.title: Narrow the contract first
options.body: Limit the initial role set or omit per-agent overrides until a smaller supported plugin contract is agreed.

options.title: Defer core support
options.body: Pause the branch and route composition experiments through current plugin seams until a maintainer-owned RFC establishes the core API.

recommendation.title: Sponsor canonical roles with Doctor migration
recommendation.body: Keep the role model, remove legacy runtime fallback readers, and require a bounded Doctor migration plus upgrade proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR explicitly sought this person’s direction on the core memory/plugin architecture, although supplied history does not prove code ownership.
